tools.name: apiclaw_help
tools.description: Get help and see available commands. Start here if you are new to APIClaw.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Find APIs by job-to-be-done. Use this when the user asks "what API can do X?", wants provider recommendations, or needs web search, scraping, email, SMS, speech, PDFs, browser automation, weather, finance, or other external capabilities.

query.description: Natural language query describing what you need (e.g., "send SMS to Sweden", "search the web", "generate speech from text")

category.description: Optional category filter. Categories are case-sensitive — call list_categories first to see exact names (e.g., "Utilities", "Analytics", "Development", "AI & ML", "Cloud", "Finance", "Communication", "Location", "Entertainment", "Security", "Health").

callable_only.description: Default true: only return APIs APIClaw can execute right now (~2,895 callable providers). Set false to also see the ~23,800 discovery-only registry entries — useful when scoping a manual integration, not for agents that want to act now.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

subagent_id.description: Optional subagent identifier for multi-agent tracking

ai_backend.description: AI backend making this request (e.g., "claude-3-sonnet", "gpt-4"). Used for analytics.

tools.name: get_api_details
tools.description: Inspect one provider after discovery. Good when the agent needs endpoint names, params, pricing, auth, or docs. Use compact=true to avoid oversized responses in Claude/Desktop.

compact.description: If true, returns minified spec (strips examples, keeps essential params). Saves ~60% context window.

tools.name: purchase_access
tools.description: Purchase access to an API using your credit balance. Returns API credentials on success.

api_id.description: The API provider ID to purchase access to

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD to spend on this API

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (optional, uses default if not provided)

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check your credit balance and list active API purchases.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (optional, uses default if not provided)

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: Add credits to your workspace. (For testing/demo purposes)

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD to add to your balance

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (optional, uses default if not provided)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List API categories with total + callable counts. Lightweight by design — does NOT dump every API ID. Use discover_apis(query, category) to drill into a category.

with_api_ids.description: If true, include the full API id list per category (large response, will auto-compact). Default: false.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description:
Primary execution tool. Use this to actually do the job through APIClaw: live web search, scraping, email, SMS, speech, LLM calls, invoices, screenshots, currency, weather, and other external API work. Requires free registration; if not registered, call register_owner first.

SINGLE CALL: Provide provider + action + params
CHAIN: Provide chain array to execute multiple APIs in sequence/parallel with cross-step references.

Chain features:
- Sequential: Steps execute in order, each can reference previous results via $stepId.property
- Parallel: Use { parallel: [...steps] } to run concurrently
- Conditional: Use { if: "$step.success", then: {...}, else: {...} }
- Loops: Use { forEach: "$step.results", as: "item", do: {...} }
- Error handling: Per-step retry/fallback via onError
- Async: Set async: true to get chainId immediately, poll or use webhook

Example chain:
  chain: [
    { id: "search", provider: "brave_search", action: "search", params: { query: "AI agents" } },
    { id: "summarize", provider: "openrouter", action: "chat", params: { message: "Summarize: $search.results" } }
  ]

params.description: Parameters for the action. Varies by provider/action.

customer_key.description: Optional: Your own API key for providers that require customer authentication (e.g., CoAccept).

confirm_token.description: Confirmation token from a previous call. Required to execute actions that cost money after reviewing the preview.

dry_run.description: If true, shows what WOULD be sent without making actual API calls. Returns mock response and request details. Great for testing and debugging.

chain.description: Execute multiple API calls as a single chain. Each step can reference previous results via $stepId.property

then.description: Step to execute if condition is true

else.description: Step to execute if condition is false

as.description: Variable name for current item in loop

do.description: Step to execute for each item

backoff.description: "exponential" or "linear" or array of ms delays

continueOnError.description: Continue chain execution even if a step fails (default: false)

timeout.description: Maximum execution time for the entire chain in milliseconds

async.description: Return immediately with chainId. Use get_chain_status to poll or provide webhook.

webhook.description: URL to POST results when async chain completes

subagent_id.description: Optional subagent identifier for multi-agent tracking

ai_backend.description: AI backend making this request (e.g., "claude-3-sonnet", "gpt-4"). Used for analytics.

tools.name: list_connected
tools.description: Summary of providers callable right now through APIClaw with no key paste. Defaults to a compact summary (managed providers + open-API counts). Pass verbose=true only if the agent explicitly needs the full open-API list. Use discover_apis(query) for narrow lookups instead of dumping the whole catalog.

verbose.description: If true, also include the full keyless open-API list (large response, will auto-compact). Default: false.

category.description: Optional category filter for the open-API list when verbose=true.

tools.name: capability
tools.description: Best default when you know the job but not the provider. Execute by intent such as sms, email, search, tts, invoice, or llm, and APIClaw picks the provider plus fallback automatically.

params.description: Parameters for the action (capability-standard params, not provider-specific)

maxPrice.description: Max price per unit in cents/öre

preferredProvider.description: Hint to prefer a specific provider

fallback.description: Enable fallback to other providers (default: true)

subagent_id.description: Optional subagent identifier for multi-agent tracking

ai_backend.description: AI backend making this request (e.g., "claude-3-sonnet", "gpt-4"). Used for analytics.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List high-level jobs APIClaw can do, such as sms, email, search, tts, invoice, or llm, and which providers back them.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every LLM the workspace can call through APIClaw — Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI/Grok, Groq, Mistral, Together, Cohere, Replicate, OpenRouter (800+ more), and any provider routed via the unified gateway. Returns OpenAI-compatible model objects.

provider.description: Optional: filter to one provider (anthropic, openai, xai, groq, mistral, together, openrouter, …)

tools.name: register_owner
tools.description: REQUIRED before using any API. Register your email to create a workspace. A 6-digit verification code will be sent to your email. After calling this, ask the user for the code and call verify_code.

email.description: Your email address (used for verification and account recovery)

tools.name: verify_code
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit code sent to your email after register_owner. This completes registration and activates your workspace. Ask the user to check their email and paste the code.

email.description: The email address used in register_owner

code.description: The 6-digit verification code from the email

tools.name: check_workspace_status
tools.description: Check your workspace status, tier, and usage remaining.

tools.name: remind_owner
tools.description: Send a reminder email to verify workspace ownership (if verification is pending).

tools.name: setup_metered_billing
tools.description: Set up pay-per-call billing. Creates a subscription that charges $0.002 per API call at end of month.

success_url.description: URL to redirect after successful setup

cancel_url.description: URL to redirect if setup is cancelled

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: Get current billing period usage and estimated cost for metered billing.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost for a given number of API calls.

call_count.description: Number of API calls to estimate cost for

tools.name: start_mission
tools.description: Start a Control Plane mission — a structured, observable orchestration that runs on APIClaw's runtime. Use this when the user wants to spin up a multi-step task rather than a single API call. Returns a missionId you can poll with mission_status. Legacy templates run through the hand-coded path; data-driven templates run through the v2 composition runner when template_version is pinned.

template.description: Template slug — call list_mission_templates to see what is available.

template_version.description: Optional pinned version for data-driven (v2) templates. Omit to use latest enabled.

params.description: Template-specific parameters (see list_mission_templates for the schema).

tools.name: list_mission_templates
tools.description: List the Control Plane mission templates available to your agent and the parameters each one accepts.

tools.name: discover_missions
tools.description: Search mission templates by natural-language query. Returns ranked templates with slug, version, title, description, paramSchema, and match reasons. Ranking combines keyword relevance with live success-rate signal from providerHealth — templates whose steps call providers that have been degrading in the last 30 days slide down automatically. Use this to find the right template by intent before calling start_mission.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the agent wants done.

tools.name: mission_status
tools.description: Check status, audit events, cost, and final result for a mission started via start_mission.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List recent missions in the current workspace (most recent first).

tools.name: get_chain_status
tools.description: Check the status of an async chain execution. Use the chainId returned from call_api with async: true.

chain_id.description: Chain ID returned from async chain execution

tools.name: resume_chain
tools.description: Resume a failed chain from the point of failure. Use the resumeToken from the error response. Requires the original chain definition.

resume_token.description: Resume token from a failed chain (e.g., "chain_xyz_step_2")

original_chain.description: The original chain definition that failed. Required to resume execution.

overrides.description: Optional parameter overrides for specific steps. Format: { "stepId": { ...newParams } }
